Job well done on time with good follow up and meter relocation and upgrade
it turns out that the same man supplied another service I installed on another property with the same professionalism

Bree from Solar storage solutions was professional, gave easy to understand information and was easy to contact for any further question.  The was no hard sell on equipment I didnt need. (ie not going for battery storage at this time meant I could use a cheaper inverter and then put that money towards better panels).   She kept me informed of all communications and steps needed to be taken.  The installation men were on time and did a very neat and efficient install.  The post install appointment to run me through the PC and phone app monitoring system was prompt and easy.  Would recommend anyone wanting Solar to go through this company.
Great service, not pushy and backed everything up with facts. Very professional.

The system was purchased through Solar Storage Solutions and installed by TAB Electrical. The system was promptly installed after the payment of a 10% deposit. Installation was incomplete due to the absence of an aerial to link the inverter to our WiFi.  Consequently, the performance of the system was not monitored for around a month.  When the aerial was finally supplied and fitted I was able to monitor its performance online.  I soon realised that the inverter was only picking up 11 of the 22 panels.  The salesman's spiel crowed that their monitoring would detect any fault with the system. This didn't happen. I brought the issue to the attention of TAB Electrical and the installing electrician came and corrected the issue the next day.  Very satisfied with their performance.  Solar Storage Solutions then invoiced me for the balance of the purchase.  I expressed my displeasure with them ie their monitoring failed and they had not given me a handover/induction to date. The owner has apologised for "dropping the ball" on monitoring and said he would get the salesman to contact me regarding a handover.  At the time of writing no contact has been made.  I understand the saleman is in the process of moving and has health and family issues.  In short I think Solar Storage Solutions administration has been sloppy.  I'm not chasing them to complete the handover and I am not paying the balance of the purchase price until they do.
The team where friend honest and willing to help with the whole set up
Noel Jago really knows his stuff, and explains everything ,simply and well. Nothing was too much trouble. Great bloke.
Absolutely fantastic customer service and communication

I had spoken with several other suppliers and found Noel from Solar Storage Solutions to be very professional and knowledgeable. Noel provided additional information that I had not been told from other suppliers which was useful in making my decisions. It was also a big plus to have a local supplier doing the installation in case we need any follow up service. I would definitely recommend Solar Storage Solutions to others.
Wanted to go with local supplier/installer
Excellent customer service

Got a quote from Solar Storage Solutions (Townsville) following Finn's advice and website reviews.   After reading pertinent information on SolarQuotes.com.au I was far more aware of systems, efficiency, panels, inverters and power consumption/calculations.  I learnt a considerable amount and was able to negotiate with installers based on knowledge and research.  Finn Peacock's well written and widely respected information is outstanding, particularly for the layperson.  Great site and brilliant support from Finn and his team.Solar Solutions was a great company to deal with, they kept in constant communication and conducted themselves professionally and ethically.   All questions were answered and the original plan to install the panels on the external shed as opposed to the roof would have been far less efficient.  Solar Storage Solutions advised me of the best and most effective location and were keen to ensure that their installation met my needs, and not necessarily just the easiest and quickest option.  As a local business they rely heavily on reputation and service, and the conduct of their operations is second to none.  Only issue was the subcontracted trenching work however they advised they will not be using the subcontractor (for digging and laying cable) again.  All in all, great service from a long time and respected installer.  Pay for quality and get a system installed by a reputable local business, it pays off every time.

The company representative seemed to know the product well and was not pushy and answered all our questions openly. The installers were punctual and professional, the did a great, very neat and tidy install. We had a couple of minor hiccups with the system to start with but that was fixed promptly without hassle. I would recommend this company anytime.
Everything was a pleasure. Company was awesome to deal with, the installers were nice and helpful. Everyone knew what they were talking about. There was a lot of variety to choose from.
I had a 10 kilowatts battery installed as well, so far it has worked brilliantly, I am using 1 kW a day from the grid and putting up to 25 kW a day into the grid.Yay no power bills .
